name: search
description: Step 1: Search memory. Returns index with IDs. Multi-word queries try the whole phrase first; if empty, split tokens are searched and results merged. Params: query, limit, project, platformSource, type, obs_type, dateStart, dateEnd, offset, orderBy

query.description: Search query (whole phrase first; auto-splits tokens on zero results)

platformSource.description: Filter by platform source (e.g. claude, codex, cursor) — restricts results to that agent's own memory
